code_examined: eso/core/src/ui-frames.mjs (US-UI-* S3 projection, not a config page)
method.baseline: PASS only if every AC's OBSERVABLE behaviour is implemented AND a test asserts it (assertion named). A data shape where the AC demands a user-visible action/state change does not pass. A stub returning success without acting does not pass.

answers_to_key_questions.real_jira_notion_call_or_local_file_pars: NEITHER. There is no Jira/Notion client anywhere in eso/ (grep 'jira|notion' finds only a comment and a template path) and no fs/HTTP IO in the ticket path (grep 'node:fs|writeFile|readFile' over eso/ finds only a caller-injected writeFileFn in scope-guard.mjs:117). 'source' is a caller-supplied label: eso/core/src/ticket-pack.mjs:67 — `const effectiveSource = localFile ? 'local' : source;`. localFile is used only for truthiness and a caller-set `deleted_branch` flag. Probe: generateExecutionPack({localFile:{path:'/tmp/eso-dd/t.json'}}) with no ticketData returns is_ready:false and missing all four sections, proving the file is never opened.
answers_to_key_questions.ticket_02_refuses_to_invent_missing_and_: PARTIALLY. It names missing fields and does not fabricate them: on an empty ticket it lists all four (AC-TICKET-02-04 passes), and a deleted parent is named (AC-TICKET-02-05 passes). But (a) the incomplete result carries NO pack body, so AC-TICKET-02-01's 'pack dùng được phần còn lại' is absent (probe: `has pack? false`); (b) INVENTED_FIELD is never emitted anywhere; (c) PACK_INCONSISTENT / AC-TICKET-02-03 is not implemented at all (grep: zero hits).
answers_to_key_questions.sdlc_01_writes_files_or_returns_plan_obj: RETURNS A PLAN OBJECT ONLY. sdlc-config.mjs has no fs import; files_created is an array of path strings (sdlc-config.mjs:220). No header, template or gate is produced. Idempotency is a caller-supplied flag (`if (isReInit)`, :181) — a real second init re-reports changed:true with the same 4 files (probe), so 're-run => 0 changes' is not implemented, only simulated by the test.
answers_to_key_questions.cfg_01_is_there_a_page_or_only_frames: ONLY FRAMES/OBJECTS. No server, route or page exists in eso/ (grep 'createServer|http.' => zero hits; eso/*/package.json export src only). ui-frames.mjs:181 projectS3Configuration is an object projection for US-UI-03 ('save_button_enabled', preview_hash), not a four-group config page. savePageConfiguration returns an object; nothing is persisted and there is no read-back API (exports are only preview/save/init/upgrade).

stories_detail.title: một page config (four-group unified configuration)
stories_detail.summary: The four-group merge, preset no-overwrite and no-op branches exist as pure functions and are asserted by tests, but there is no page, no persistence, no read-back and no config hash on a saved version; two AC-named error codes (ROOT_CHANGE_UNPLANNED, CONFIG_FORBIDDEN) are replaced by the implementation's own codes and the tests assert the substitutes, so the AC contract is not what is proven.

acs.implemented: All four groups are merged into one object before version bump (atomic in memory). No persistence, no read-back API, and the saved result has no hash field (probe: save keys = unchanged,version,project,groups,skipped_roles,saved_at,saved_by; 'hash in sv' = false).

acs.implemented: Refuses and returns affected_paths. Error code is MIGRATION_PLAN_REQUIRED, not ROOT_CHANGE_UNPLANNED. Nothing is written either way (0 changes trivially true).

stories_detail.title: thiết lập SDLC (init / upgrade)
stories_detail.summary: The whole story is a plan generator: no file, header, template or gate is ever written, idempotency is faked with a caller-supplied isReInit flag (a genuine second init re-reports changed:true), tenant/scoping does not exist, and upgrade is a stub returning success:true + can_revert:true with no revert action. This is exactly the 'stub returning success without acting' and 'data shape where the AC demands a state change' failure modes.

acs.expected: init generates tree, header, template, gates per profile; re-run => 0 changes; postcondition lists created/existing artefacts
acs.implemented: Returns a hardcoded list of four path strings. No fs write, no header, no gates. Idempotency is only a caller flag: if isReInit then 0 files. A real second call returns changed:true and the same 4 files (probe), i.e. no created/existing distinction.
acs.assertion: qc/eso-kb-sdlc-config.test.mjs:180 'SCN-SDLC-01-01' — :189 `assert.equal(initResult.files_created.length, 4);` then :195 passes `isReInit: true` and asserts changed:false. The test supplies the very flag that produces the 'idempotent' result.
acs.gap: No artefact is generated; idempotency is a tautological flag test (test never runs init twice). Probe: init run1 changed=true 4 files, run2 changed=true 4 files.

acs.expected: refuse when a declaration (sdlc_root) is missing, name what is missing, 0 files generated; error CONFIG_INCOMPLETE
acs.implemented: Throws MISSING_CONFIG with missing_fields ['sdlc_root'] and files_created [].
acs.assertion: qc/eso-kb-sdlc-config.test.mjs:202 'SCN-SDLC-01-02' — :209 `assert.equal(err.code, 'MISSING_CONFIG');` :210 missing_fields ['sdlc_root'].
acs.gap: CONFIG_INCOMPLETE never emitted (grep: 0 hits); test asserts the substitute code.

acs.expected: only generate what matches applies_when; the rest is marked OUT with a reason; OUT list recorded
acs.implemented: Templates are a hardcoded 4-item list (not profile-driven) filtered by has_fe/has_jira flags; out_scope entries carry template + reason. The OUT list is returned only, never recorded, and the 'generated' half of the claim is vacuous because nothing is generated.
acs.assertion: qc/eso-kb-sdlc-config.test.mjs:215 'SCN-SDLC-01-03' — :224 `assert.equal(result.out_scope.length, 1);` :225 asserts the frontend template path.
evidence: eso/knowledge/src/sdlc-config.mjs:204 — `if (t.tag === 'frontend' && appliesWhen.has_fe === false) {` :205 `outScope.push({ template: t.path, reason: ... })`
acs.gap: OUT list not persisted; applies_when is two ad-hoc booleans, not a declaration/profile evaluation.

acs.expected: init for project A changes only A; project B unchanged; 0 changes in B; error OUT_OF_SCOPE
acs.implemented: No scope parameter, no store, no tenant guard, no OUT_OF_SCOPE in this module. The function cannot see project B, so 'B untouched' is vacuously true because nothing is ever written.
acs.assertion: qc/eso-kb-sdlc-config.test.mjs:228 'SCN-SDLC-01-04 / tenant: Init on Project A leaves Project B completely untouched' — the test body (:229-234) never mentions or inspects project B; it only asserts `resA.project === 'project-A'`.
evidence: eso/knowledge/src/sdlc-config.mjs:149 — `export function initProjectSdlc({ project, config = {}, appliesWhen = {}, existingArtefacts = [], isReInit = false } = {}) {` (no scope/isolation input)
acs.gap: Test name claims isolation but asserts nothing about B; OUT_OF_SCOPE absent from the whole SDLC path (grep hits only IAM/control-plane).

acs.expected: upgrade all projects sharing the standard, with impact list, a one-action revert, and upgrade event + reverted_by
acs.implemented: Stub: returns success:true, upgraded_count = input length, an impact array synthesized from the input, can_revert:true. Nothing is upgraded, no revert function exists for upgrade, no event, no reverted_by.
acs.assertion: qc/eso-kb-sdlc-config.test.mjs:237 'SCN-SDLC-01-05' — :249 `assert.equal(upgrade.upgraded_count, 3);` :250 impact.length 3 :251 `assert.equal(upgrade.can_revert, true);` (asserts the claim, not a revert).
acs.gap: No upgrade action, no revert action, no reverted_by; test asserts a boolean the stub hardcodes.

acs.expected: blank project (0 SDLC folders) generates the full tree; existing[] empty; every artefact marked created
acs.implemented: Returns changed:true and four path strings. No existing[] field and no per-artefact created status (probe: 'existing' in result = false).

evidence: eso/knowledge/src/sdlc-config.mjs:216 — `return {` :217 `changed: true,` :220 `files_created: generatedFiles,` (no existing[], no created flags)

acs.expected: changed sdlc_root with artefacts at the old root => no second tree, report artefacts still at the old root, do not auto-fix, 0 files written, the divergence list is recorded
acs.implemented: Throws DANGLING_ARTEFACTS_ROOT carrying only one existing_root (the first match) and writes nothing. The AC's error column is '—' (expected: report, not error) and asks for a recorded divergence list; only a single root value is exposed.
